sql: SELECT count(*) n,count_if(o.props_json<>s.new_props OR p.props_json<>s.new_props OR o.retained_json<>s.retained_json OR p.retained_json<>s.retained_json OR o.entity_version<>6 OR p.entity_version<>6) bad FROM client_dev.ashlar_stream_20261005_e2.stage_6 s JOIN client_dev.ashlar_stream_20261005_e2.objects o ON s.id=o.id JOIN client_dev.ashlar_stream_20261005_e2.serving p ON s.id=p.id WHERE o.id>500000 AND o.id<=600000 AND p.id>500000 AND p.id<=600000

label: journal-validate-6
sql: SELECT count(*) n,count_if(from_json(concat('[',j.old_json,']'),'ARRAY<STRING>')[0] IS DISTINCT FROM get_json_object(s.props_json,'$.103') OR from_json(concat('[',j.new_json,']'),'ARRAY<STRING>')[0] IS DISTINCT FROM get_json_object(s.new_props,'$.103')) bad FROM client_dev.ashlar_stream_20261005_e2.journal j JOIN client_dev.ashlar_stream_20261005_e2.stage_6 s ON j.id=s.id WHERE j.batch=6
